name: 2nd EVE
detailed_description:
Synopsis:

The Moon was shattered. A mysterious impact knocked it off course, and now it’s on a slow, inevitable collision with Earth. Humanity’s last hope lies in three massive colony ships bound for the closest thing to a new Earth - Proxima B.

You play as Sister Zola - a nun, psychiatrist, and high-ranking officer - tasked with protecting the minds of the colonists during their long cryosleep slumber. But hyperspace, as you will soon discover, is not empty - for some devils have found their way through.

When the Argos jumps into the unknown, reality fractures. The crew loses their minds - or their souls. Some awaken changed, twisted into nightmare beings. Rogue machines stalk the corridors. The ship itself becomes a hostile, ever-shifting maze.

Armed with faith, newfound powers, and your precious staff, you must fight your way through the shattered halls of Argos. Save who you can. Destroy what you must. And pray that, in the abyss of hyperspace, you don’t lose your soul too.

Key Features:

  • Brutal Combat: Master a combat system built on skill, timing, and strategy. Face rogue AI, mutated crew & horrors of hyperspace. Upgrade your weapons, harness new abilities, and carve your way through the nightmarish corridors of the ARGOS.

  • Narrative-Driven Exploration: Piece together the fate of the ARGOS through scattered logs, corrupted transmissions, and hidden lore. As the ship’s spiritual guardian, your mission is more than survival  - it is the salvation of the colony, the future of humanity, and perhaps, eternal life itself.

  • Atmospheric Sci-Fi Horror: Explore eerie, desolate environments filled with tension and danger. From the frozen cryo chambers to the ruined command deck, every area hides crucial clues and deadly threats to the fate of the colony.

  • Choice and Consequence:  The survival of the mission - and the last remnants of mankind- rest in your hands. Who will you save? What will you sacrifice? Every decision shapes the ship’s fate, and some choices might just come back to haunt you…

short_description: In 2nd EVE, a sci-fi side-scrolling combat RPG, you're Zola, Sister Superior of the colony spaceship ARGOS. After a catastrophic hyperspace event, battle rogue machines, twisted crew, and deadly anomalies to protect humanity's last hope—the cryo sleepers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R7 370 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p resolution, low settings, stable at 30+ FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p resolution, high settings, stable at 60+ FPS
